spans.s: होतृ (I) a. (f. त्री) Sacrificing, offering oblation into fire, या हविर्या च होत्री Sak.i.
होतृ (II) m. 1. A priest who recites the prayers of the Ṛgveda at a sacrifice; 2. a sacrifice in general, R.i.62, 82.
होतृ (I) a. (f. त्री) Sacrificing, offering oblation into fire, या हविर्या च होत्री Sak.i.
होत्र n. 1. A sacrifice, a burnt offering; 2. any thing fit for offering as an oblation.
होत्रीय m. The priest who offers an oblation to the gods by casting clarified butter into the fire.
